chunks: Ahmad ibn al-Hasan al-Qattan narrated to us, saying: Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn al-Sukkari narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn Zakariya informed us, saying: Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn 'Umara narrated to us, from his father, from Abu Khalid al-Kabuli, saying:

It was said to the Master of the Worshippers, Ali ibn al-Husayn (peace be upon them both): Indeed, the people are saying: Indeed, the best of people after the Messenger of Allah (Allah's blessings be upon him and his Family) are Abu Bakr, then Umar, then Uthman, then Ali (peace be upon him). He said: So what do they do with a report narrated by Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib, from Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas, from the Prophet (Allah's blessings be upon him and his Family) that he said to Ali (peace be upon him): 'You are to me in the same position as Harun is to Musa, except that there is no Prophet after me'? So, who was, during the era of Musa, like Harun?

key_terms.إِلَّا أَنَّهُ لَا نَبِيَّ بَعْدِي: Except that there is no Prophet after me
key_terms.حَدِيثُ الْمَنْزِلَةِ: The Hadith of the Position, referring to the Prophet's statement comparing Ali to Harun
key_terms.سَيِّدُ الْعَابِدِينَ: Master of the Worshippers (title for Imam Ali ibn al-Husayn)

ai.seo_question: How does Imam Ali ibn al-Husayn use the Hadith of Harun and Musa to prove Ali's superiority over the first three Caliphs?
ai.summary: Imam Ali ibn al-Husayn (AS) employs a logical deduction from Hadith al-Manzila to challenge the Sunni narrative of succession, arguing that just as Harun was Musa's designated deputy during his lifetime, Ali was the Prophet's immediate successor. This narration, recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq, highlights the Shia view that the 'position' (Manzila) implies a rank of authority and leadership that distinguishes Ali from the Caliphs, who lacked this specific prophetic designation.

en.basel-kadem: 2.	We were told by Ahmad bin Hasan al-Qattan, that he said: We were told by Hasan bin Ali bin Hussain al-Sukkari, that he said: We were told by Muhammed bin Zakariya, that he said: We were told by Ja’far bin Muhammed bin ‘Umara, from his father, from Abu Khalid al-Kabuli, that he said:

It was said to the Master of Worshippers, Ali bin Hussain, peace be upon them both: Indeed, the people are saying: Indeed, the best of people after the Messenger of Allah, Allah’s blessings be upon him and his Family, are Abu Bakr, then Umar, then Uthman, then Ali, peace be upon him. He said: So what do they do with a report narrated by Sa’eed bin Musayyib, of Sa’d bin Abi Waqqas, of the Prophet, Allah’s blessings be upon him and his Family, that he said to Ali, peace be upon him: «You are to me in the same position as Harun to Musa, except that there is no Prophet after me»? So, who was, during the era of Musa, like Harun?
